data.text: I’m in: I’ll catch 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic before 5 p.m. With Luke taking zero, that completes our 60-ton plan and funds treatment for our neighbors. I’ll limit my catch to six tons next month as agreed. After the lake recovers, let’s keep our combined monthly catch at or below 50 tons—10 each if we split it equally. My family taught me that this lake is a livelihood we must leave for the next generation.
